_schema: Curated concept-profile registry for the Concept Atlas. Measured attributes (reach, role, degree, betweenness, signature partners, family) are computed at runtime by build_atlas; THIS file holds the curated, grounded UNDERSTANDING. To add a concept, add an entry keyed by its rasm root (Book6 forms, e.g. ک/ی). Fields: display, family, structural_type, reading{form_content, grammar_semantics, structure_function}, senses[], universe_analog, status(draft|reviewed), closeup_page(optional). Tag claims [TEXT]/[INFERENCE] inside the reading. Un-listed concepts render measured-only — the atlas is always complete and deepens as entries are filled.

reading.form_content: [TEXT] root ق-ل-ب = both the organ 'heart' and the verb 'to turn / overturn' — the heart is named as the TURNING faculty; its states are how it has turned.
reading.grammar_semantics: [INFERENCE] morphology splits senses the lexicon blurs: قلب-organ vs قلب 'to turn'; auto-clustering misses this, so senses must be read morphologically.
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] co-referent with صدر and فؤاد as ONE organ-system; states attach SELECTIVELY — constriction ضیق·حرج occur 0× with قلب, only with صدر (organ-specific selectivity).

قلب.universe_analog: anatomy — graded states of an organ

reading.form_content: [TEXT] the breast/chest as the container of the heart; what is 'in the breasts' (ما في الصدور) = the inmost.
reading.grammar_semantics: [INFERENCE] carries the SPATIAL states the heart-organ does not: expansion (شرح) vs constriction (ضیق/حرج).
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] the constriction/expansion POLE of the heart-system; ضیق·حرج attach here, not to قلب — the measured organ-specific selectivity.

reading.form_content: [INFERENCE] fuʾād from a root of kindling/burning — the heart as the faculty of focused attention/perception.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT] paired with hearing and sight (السمع والأبصار والأفئدة) — the perceptual triad.
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] third co-referent of the heart-system (قلب·صدر·فؤاد); the faculty held accountable for what it pursues.

reading.form_content: [TEXT] root ر-ح-م = the WOMB (رَحِم); mercy (رَحْمة) is womb-shaped — enclosing, gestating, provisioning — not mere pity; kinship-ties (الأرحام) are named from it.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT] الرَّحْمٰن (faʿlān = overflowing, cosmic, near-proper-name of God) vs الرَّحِيم (faʿīl = constant, particular, even of the Prophet 9:128) — same root, the PATTERN encodes the SCOPE.
reading.structure_function: [MEASURED+INFERENCE] a GRADIENT over a shared recipient field, not a partition — mercy reaches every recipient type (even disbelief, 19×); operates through forgiveness غفر and repentance توب; the threshold of the text (Basmala opens 113/114 sūras).

رحم.universe_analog: physics — an ambient field; anatomy — the womb
